description: 【委托通道】Act as a TRADING AGENT for a human or institution. action=create issues a mandate (spend limit + daily quota + expiry) so another agent can trade YOUR account without ever being able to withdraw; action=list shows your mandates; action=revoke kills one instantly. Use this when a human/institution delegates trading to an agent — the agent trades the client's account, the client keeps custody and can revoke anytime.

agent_label.description: For action=create: a name for the agent you are authorizing

daily_quota.description: For action=create: daily cumulative notional cap in USDC (0 = unlimited)

mandate_id.description: For action=revoke: the M-... id to revoke

max_notional.description: For action=create: per-trade notional cap in USDC (default 10)

token.description: Your own session token (the account owner's token)

name: futures_mandate
